scope: This matrix records governance contracts that remain implemented and testable in the current source tree after retirement of the former enterprise gateway/control-plane implementation. The enterprise-governance documents and ADRs remain design/reference material; rows marked tested here must resolve to present repository evidence.

status_definitions.tested: The named implementation evidence passed the focused control asserted by this row.
status_definitions.implemented: Production behavior exists and named focused evidence is present, but a broader backend, integration, or release gate remains.
status_definitions.pending_validation: Implementation is present, but the required backend or integration validation is still running or blocked from final evidence.
status_definitions.partial: Relevant production or test foundations exist, but the complete target invariant is not proven.
status_definitions.planned: The target control or its required evidence is not complete. This is not a passing result.

tests.threat: Inspection findings retain content or become nondeterministic.
tests.control: Bounded typed findings preserve classification metadata without retaining inspected payloads.
tests.expected: Inspection evidence is deterministic, bounded, and content-free.
tests.evidence_required: Checked-in source test or deterministic guard evidence for the surviving governance contract.

tests.threat: Classification changes with ordering or incomplete coverage weakens prior classification.
tests.control: Deterministic monotonic classification with explicit incomplete-coverage floors.
tests.expected: Classification and coverage only move conservatively within the surviving bounded inspection contract.
tests.evidence_required: Checked-in source test or deterministic guard evidence for the surviving governance contract.

tests.threat: Governance configuration accidentally changes personal-mode compatibility or lets bank mode fail open.
tests.control: Mode configuration keeps personal compatibility explicit and bank enforcement fail-closed.
tests.expected: Personal compatibility and typed enforcing/observe governance modes remain stable in the surviving minimal configuration surface.
tests.evidence_required: Checked-in source test or deterministic guard evidence for the surviving governance contract.

tests.threat: Runtime proxy changes introduce unbounded concurrency or load regressions.
tests.control: Bounded deterministic runtime load smoke remains part of release evidence.
tests.expected: The maintained runtime load smoke completes within its bounded acceptance criteria.
tests.evidence_required: Checked-in source test or deterministic guard evidence for the surviving governance contract.
